text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh... So that's Air Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Uh, she looks pretty scary. You should
probably
tone it down...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like at the academy, other people
seem to
find Air Shakur a bit of an
outsider. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's exactly why I can't help but
wonder
something. There's no doubt
that Air Shakur is
one of the top talents
in her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So why is Parcae predicting that she
won't be able
to win? It's almost as if
they're putting her
through a trial.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has been occupied with her
laptop
ever since we returned to the
academy, feeding
Parcae the data from
the race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's within the margin of error. As I
thought,
Parcae's accuracy is
impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Although...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just my heart rate was higher than
expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't make it weird. Excitement levels
can be
calculated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Emotion is an unstable variable,
however, so it's
inefficient to convert
into data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't it? I'd have to figure out how
to
reliably quantify emotions, compile
the data, and
then verify it. It'd take way
too long.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the conditions are way
too
limited, so the resulting data would
be practically
useless. Inefficient as hell.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's why I classify the emotional data
into
categories and compress whatever
can't be
categorized. That keeps the
data integrity as high
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I probably ought to grab some fresh
data of me
running with an increased
heart rate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I've figured it out now.
Problem
solved.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, about our next goal... Parcae is
predicting
that I'll get on the scoreboard
in the Hopeful
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes is a high-stakes
junior G1
race. Those who perform well
attract a lot of
interest and attention
from the fans for their
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, it's just a matter of
increasing
my stats to the values I need
to become a Double
Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This could be the key to narrowing that

seven-centimeter gap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly realize something. If Shakur
will be
seven centimeters behind, that
means someone
else will be seven
ahead. But who?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Beats me.
choice_data_list: 7cmって、誰との差なんだろうね

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much data I input, I can
only ever
catch a glimpse of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I knew who it was, my calculations
would be so
much easier.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I can confirm is that I lose
to
someone by a margin of seven
centimeters. That's
it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I need to gather more data
before the
Hopeful Stakes.
